experiments.study_type: Bone fracture and skin wound models
experiments.procedure_text: Bone fractures were generated on the right femurs of adult male mice using a 3-point bending device, following surgical stabilization with an intramedullary needle.
experiments.procedure_text_evidence: Bone fractures were generated on the right femurs of adult male mice. ... A 0.5-mm-diameter needle was inserted into the intramedullary canal to stabilize the impending fracture.
experiments.test_system_evidence: Bone fractures were generated on the right femurs of adult male mice.
experiments.route_evidence: Mice were anesthetized by an intraperitoneal injection of 40 mg kg -1 sodium pentobarbital

endpoints.label: Bone fracture healing
endpoints.evidence: Prrx1 + cells are required for bone fracture and skin wound healing.
